goal: Open three reports that distinguish value from incentives.
canStill: Inspect evidence, ask a question, review your commitments, or pause.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: The payout ledger has a rhythm nobody budgeted for.

items.label: Payout ledger
items.detail: Shows $410k paid weekly, not the displayed $120k.
items.soWhat: Shows the outgoing rewards the dashboard misses.

items.label: Cohort value
items.detail: Shows which referrals later buy useful services.
items.soWhat: Shows who buys after a referral.

items.label: Device fingerprints
items.detail: Shows one device controlling many accounts.

items.label: Community threads
items.soWhat: Shows how neighbors use the rewards.

items.label: Partner contracts
items.soWhat: Shows which promises are already in writing.

items.label: Cash forecast
items.detail: Shows twelve weeks of cash at current burn.
